verdict.rationale: Netlify's core model is Git-based deploys with auto-deploy on push, PR previews, and CLI/API for automation, fitting standard Git/CI workflows without requiring proprietary tooling; community evidence corroborates GitHub integration and CI-like preview builds working well in practice. missing for 10: explicit documentation of editor-agnostic support and broader CI provider compatibility beyond Netlify's own build system, plus independent confirmation of framework-agnostic behavior across many stacks.
